newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada urges democratic elections in Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: Canada urges democratic elections in Hong Kong.

text.p: Canada's Foreign Minister Lloyd Axworthy urged Hong Kong on Wednesday to hold democratic elections within a year after it becomes part of China.

"We have tried to impress upon the Chinese the necessity to have democratic elections as soon as possible," Axworthy told reporters after he was reappointed to the foreign affairs portfolio in Canada's new Liberal government.
"When I was in Hong Kong this spring, I did receive a commitment that there would be democratic elections by next July, so if they hold to that timetable, it would be a step forward," Axworthy said.
He added that Canada would have high-level representation at the the handover ceremony on July 1, when Hong Kong puts an end to 150 years of being a British colony and becomes part of China.
